title: Hotkey
description: x-hotkey binds a keyboard shortcut to its host: pressing key anywhere on the page flashes the host, fires wb:hotkey:triggered and clicks it. The shortcut is shown in a badge inside the host. Without key it shows a warning and does nothing.

key.description: The shortcut, as modifiers and a key joined by +, e.g. `ctrl+k` or `ctrl+shift+s`. Modifiers: ctrl (or control), alt, shift, meta (or cmd). Required.

wb:hotkey:triggered.description: The shortcut was pressed, just before the host is clicked.

_metadata.derivedFrom: helpers.js hotkey() — every property here is one the behavior reads
